title: FEP Agent Append-only Run Event v0.2
description: v0.2 event system (ADR-0010 §5.3/§11.6): five independent mechanism event types; neutral_inquiry and retrieval_completion_check are retired from the current enum and only exist on the v0.1 track for historical journal replay. GAP-RETRIEVAL-TOOLS adds retrieval_mode_transition, retrieval_result_committed and retrieval_activation_restored (ADR-0010 §3.7.1/§3.3.3/§3.3). FUS-RETRIEVAL-MECH P0-B step 5 (2026-08-14) adds citation_validation (ADR-0010 §3.7.9 output-level citation verifier; RETRIEVAL_MECHANICAL_CONTROLS_DESIGN §3.2). F7 (2026-08-15) adds epoch_archive_write_failed (blackboard plan-epoch archive write failure audit trace, ADR-0010 §14.15). ORZ-ORIENTATION-FORCED-TEMPLATE (2026-08-15, ADR-0010 §14.16) adds checkpoint_response (forced-template checkpoint round answer + mechanical validation + evidence-identity cross-check; ADR-0010 §4.2/§4.6). ORZ-CACHE-CONTEXT-COST (2026-08-15, ADR-0010 §3.5 条6/§14.9) adds request_header_change (model-request header = system+tools+config fingerprint; only emitted on initial/change for cache-miss attribution and probe-accuracy auditing). PLAN-FIRST 阶段 A (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17) adds plan_write (first-round plan gate result: plan identity/goal/step count, mechanical validation, one-refill attempt progression and degrade reason; PLAN_FIRST_BLACKBOARD_DESIGN §3-§5). PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱) adds console_mode_transition (console/direct dual-mode transition decision record; PLAN_FIRST_BLACKBOARD_DESIGN §7) and console_order_written (blackboard_action_write order identity + step binding + mechanical stamps; PLAN_FIRST_BLACKBOARD_DESIGN §5-§6). P0-E 第 4 项 (2026-08-17, ADR-0010 §14.21 项 3) adds console_order_rejected (pre-issuance rejection of a written order — order_stale / step_not_done / budget_insufficient / registry / contract / target / ACAF / policy / mode gates — carrying order identity, envelope step, phase, rejection code and reason; the result-bar receipt stays as the human-readable view).
